grounding_contract: Document-dependent tasks require observed source provenance; self-contained/reference tasks may derive from user facts. Generic core also exposes this through --source-required, with abstention allowed; no fixed tool sequence or minimum action count.
source_policy: No data cleaning, rewriting, filtering, or repartitioning; reuse existing exact context and v2 tree/entity indexes
exposure: Both datasets, earlier v2 results and complete v3-v1 negative results are known. Post-hoc development, not unseen-test confirmation. Public task contracts and independent fixtures motivate changes; no gold in model prompts, per-case rules, or test-answer memory.
selection: all19 math and all125 Multi-Document QA; report every outcome, no question-level routing or favorable subset selection
reference_policy: Historical direct/BM25 and v2 are reference results; v3-v1 is preserved as a complete negative condition. New language-aligned instructions, query anchoring, explicit output contracts, grounding policy and optional computations are disclosed.
